schedule.overallHint: Compares actual progress with the progress planned for the time elapsed. Green: actual at or above plan · Yellow: up to 10 points below · Red: more than 10 points below.
schedule.empty: No tasks in this Board yet.
schedule.exportXmlHint: Downloads the schedule as XML in the MSPDI standard — open it in Microsoft Project via File › Open (or any other app that reads that standard). The .MPP format is binary and proprietary, with no public write specification, so we use XML, the official interchange format.
schedule.compareHint: Shows two bars per task: actual progress on top, progress planned for the time elapsed below.
schedule.fromTasksHint: These numbers come from the schedule tasks. To change them, open the project schedule.
schedule.emptyProject: No tasks in the schedule yet. Use "New task" to start.
schedule.predecessorsHint: Enter WBS codes separated by commas (e.g. 1.1, 1.2)
schedule.importNone: No other card with a schedule in this Space yet.
schedule.importRestartHint: Shifts every date, keeping durations and gaps.
schedule.importAdds: Tasks will be added to the current schedule (nothing is deleted).
schedule.summaryLocked: Summary row: dates, duration, %, work and cost are rolled up from the child tasks.
schedule.durationHint: In working days — fractions allowed: 0.5 = half a day (4 h on an 8 h day), 1.5 = a day and a half.
schedule.noResources: No resources registered yet. Click "New resource".
schedule.resourcesHint: Assign a resource to a task and enter the hours — the cost is computed automatically (hours × hourly cost).
schedule.deleteResourceConfirm: Delete the resource "{{name}}"? Tasks remain, just without the resource.
schedule.workdaysHint: Unchecked days are skipped when computing durations.
schedule.calendarHint: Task durations count only this calendar's working days — weekends and holidays are skipped.
schedule.keyboardHint: In any cell: ↑ ↓ move between rows · Enter adds a row below · Tab on the last column (Notes) also adds one. Duration and Work update each other both ways; in Automatic mode duration also fills the dates. The arrow next to the bin cycles phase › task › subtask.

landing.badge: CRM · Projects · Tasks — in one app
landing.sub: Sales pipeline, project schedule and task board in the same place. Instead of paying for and learning three systems, your team uses one — and starts working today.
landing.noCard: No credit card. Takes less than a minute.
landing.p1Title: A CRM that remembers your clients
landing.p1Text: Register the company and the contact person once, then reuse them on every new deal.
landing.p1a: Visual pipeline: from lead to won
landing.p1c: Value, source, feeling and next contact
landing.p2Text: Every card is a full project, with phases, tasks and a Gantt chart inside it.
landing.p2b: Resources with hourly cost and a working-day calendar
landing.p2c: Actual vs planned Gantt and export to MS Project
landing.p3Text: The drag-and-drop board your team picks up in five minutes.
landing.p3a: Board, list and report over the same data
landing.p3b: Checklists, labels, attachments and your own fields
landing.p3c: Owners, due dates and an overdue traffic light
landing.oneAppTitle: One app, one subscription, one trained team.
landing.oneAppText: Simple and straight to the point: the client who enters the pipeline becomes a project with a schedule, which becomes a task on the board. No copying data between systems, no consultant to roll it out, no training the team three times.
landing.s1: Create your Space and pick a ready-made template: CRM, Projects or Tasks.
landing.s2: Invite the team and set who can do what.
landing.s3: Follow everything in the report, no spreadsheet needed.
landing.extrasTitle: And all of this comes along
landing.extrasText: No extra module, no charging per feature.
landing.x1: Pipeline and deadline reports, with charts and export
landing.x2: Alerts for tasks coming due, linking straight to the card
landing.x3: Export to Excel, PDF and XML for MS Project
landing.x4: Email invites and access profiles per Space
landing.x5: Portuguese, English and Spanish, light and dark themes
landing.forWhoTitle: Built for people who sell, deliver and follow up
landing.w1: Sales teams losing deals for lack of follow-up
landing.w2: Anyone delivering projects with deadline, scope and cost to control
landing.w3: Small teams with no time to roll out a big system
landing.closeTitle: Start now and set up your first Space today.
landing.closeText: The free plan is already enough for real work. When you need more, it is your call.
landing.galleryText: The same screens your team will use on day one.
landing.g1Text: Drag cards between columns. Client, value, due date and labels right on the card.
landing.g2Text: Phases, tasks and subtasks with automatic dates. Change one duration and the rest rebuilds itself.
landing.g3Text: Dependencies, today line and performance status. Export to PDF or XML for MS Project.
landing.g4Text: Open value, conversion and wins per month — with export to Excel and PDF.
